integrity: The finite rational inequalities and all-size analytic proof are included; executable checks are reproducible but are not independent certification. No author or external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform strictly convex polygon triangulations and centered ear indicators, n>=5. The constant mode is null at n=5; the condition ratio uses positive spectrum. Absolute historical priority is unconfirmed, and general weighted/partial triangulation models are excluded.
title: Sharp harmonic observability crossover for ear patterns of random polygon triangulations
